cell.label: Patient with suspected new TIA (no fixed deficit at time of presentation)
Speech deficit, unilateral motor loss, or unilateral sensory loss?
Reassess whether patient has TIA; consider neurologic consultation.
Dexstick, CBC, Chem 7, PT/PTT, UA, ECG/cardiac monitoring, noncontrast head CT.
Glucose or electrolyte abnormalities, atrial fibrillation, intracranial mass, bleed?
Perform expedited workup for stroke As an inpatient or in the ER.
Did event occur within 7 days and ABCD2 5 or more?
Schedule workup that should be completed within 1 wk.

footnotes.footnote: Expedited workup consists of noninvasive carotid imaging (contrast-enhanced neck MRA, neck MRA, carotid duplex ultrasonography, or CTA), and transthoracic echocardiography (TTE). Perform transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) in patients <45 y old and in patients whose presentation is suspicious for emboli.
